name: RNAstructure
summary: Local RNA/DNA secondary-structure prediction, base-pair probabilities and experimental constraint integration.

steps: Read the official RNAstructure download page and GPLv2 terms. The reviewed release is 6.6 (April 2, 2026); choose the GUI or command-line distribution for the user's OS and CPU rather than treating them as interchangeable.

Download from the maintainer's HTTPS page using the user's own machine. The published MD5 list can help detect accidental corruption but is not a cryptographic authenticity guarantee; this recipe does not pin a reviewed SHA-256 or execute the installer/archive automatically.

Follow the package's bundled installation help. For command-line programs, keep the thermodynamic data_tables directory with the installation and set DATAPATH as the official help requires. Make environment changes only in the chosen session or explicitly approved scope; do not overwrite unrelated global settings.
Run the installed Fold program's help and then a small maintainer example to check access to the thermodynamic tables. Do not send user sequences to the optional web server.
install.verify_note: For the selected command-line distribution, run Fold --help and an official short example with the documented DATAPATH; GUI verification is separate. A help screen alone does not prove the parameter tables can be read.

notes: RNAstructure is a thermodynamic secondary-structure tool, not protein-RNA docking or a general RNA 3D predictor. Local binaries and source are documented for all three OSes, but specific CPU compatibility and installer behavior remain user-verified; this route is guidance-only.
